containers.note: List area; web crt.DataTable maps to mobile crt.List.

components.note: Folder tree. The mobile template (BaseMobileListTemplate) already provides the FolderTreeActions element; carry the web folder-schema binding (sourceSchemaName + rootSchemaName) onto it by merge-by-name so the mobile folder tree resolves the section entity. Without this the web crt.FolderTree node (inherited template chrome) is pruned and rootSchemaName is lost.

templates.note: Tabbed record page (Tabs + Feed + Attachments). Preferred target for web tabbed record pages.

containers.note: The mobile template provides the Feed and Attachments tabs (FeedTab, AttachmentsTab) — they stay LAST. Converted web tabs already arrive with explicit indexes right after the general tab, so applying the element map verbatim yields: general tab, converted web tabs, Feed, Attachments.
Feed tab content; the FeedTab stays the second-to-last tab (before Attachments).
Attachments tab content; the AttachmentsTab stays the LAST tab.
All tabs except Feed and Attachments should be moved to Tabs

Web card-content wrapper; its non-tab content (side/profile) fills the mobile general tab's grid. The profile island itself is the exception — see the SideAreaProfileContainer entry: it merges into AreaProfileContainer, not into the general tab's grid.

Web profile island (the styled side-area grid with color/borderRadius). Merge twin — do NOT recreate it: the mobile template already provides AreaProfileContainer inside GeneralTabContainer as the profile card, so this wrapper's children are placed INSIDE AreaProfileContainer (never directly into GeneralTabContainer, and never leave AreaProfileContainer empty). Sibling side-area blocks (e.g. a second card like CaseInfoContainer) are NOT the island — they stay ordinary inserts into GeneralTabContainer. The island's own styling is template-provided and is not carried; if the web wrapper carries a BOUND visible or is targeted by business rules, move that logic onto AreaProfileContainer or each promoted child — it is not carried automatically.
Content ABOVE the web card-content wrapper (e.g. a progress bar) is placed above the mobile Tabs (in the Tabs' parent container).
Content BELOW the web card-content wrapper is placed below the mobile Tabs.

components.note: Attachments detail. Same component on both sides (crt.FileList) under a different template name, so the page's delta over the web-template baseline — the object-specific link column recordColumnName included — merges onto the template-provided AttachmentFileList; an unchanged property is omitted so the mobile default (e.g. RecordId) stands.

templates.note: Base record page (non-tabbed). Web BasePageFreedomTemplate maps to the mobile base record page.
Blank page. Mobile blank exposes only the Scaffold root.
Base page template; maps to the mobile base record page. Universal fallback container is MainContainer.
Base web template root; maps to the mobile structural root. Universal fallback container is MainContainer.

components.note: Boolean fields on mobile use crt.Toggle instead of the web crt.Checkbox.
Rich text on mobile uses crt.RichTextEditor instead of the web crt.HtmlEditor.
Many->one: mobile FolderTreeActions is produced from web crt.FolderTree (primary); web crt.FolderTreeActions is consumed. Values are reconciled against the mobile component's registry contract.

componentPropertyOverrides.note: ENG-94230: crt.IndicatorWidget has no top-level size/hideBorder input - XS is the fontSizeMode enum value and hide-border is layout.border.hidden, so this rule merges instead of replacing to keep config.data (without which the widget renders nothing).
